items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Charlie Calloway, colored boy, he was the MC on the show

ctx.x: Well did any of the guys you know ever get in serious trouble, say, you know, down

behind the sun as we say? No, one boy named Charlie Calloway, we was playing, I was playing with the same shooting, this happened in Atlanta, Georgia, was it? Yeah, Atlanta, Georgia. And the white guy was drunk, you know, he kept on buying him, kept on buying him, he was selling Coca-Cola, you know, around him, and all the white folks, he didn't keep on following the boy around. Who was selling Coke all the time? Charlie Calloway, colored boy, he was the MC on the show, but before the show go on, you know, to…
with Tony Parham? I think I played it for you one time. Yeah. What was the Blue Island?
